scope: Bounded retained-evidence and primary-document research; no heavy/native/GIS/fetch execution, scientific dataset download, geometry operation, source raster, patch, import or territorial decision.

target.centre_method: Longitude=(x+0.5)/size*360-180. Latitude read as little-endian float64 at y*8 from the exact retained native-row-latitudes table. Standard inverse Mercator formula gave 18.28459969213187; retained value remains authoritative.

primary_sources.title: U.S. Department of State, International Boundary Study No. 63, Burma-Thailand Boundary
primary_sources.date: 1966-02-01, verified from cover; FSU index lists 1968 in error
primary_sources.publisher_and_host: Primary official U.S. State Department document retained by FSU Law library; not a current bilateral determination
primary_sources.inspected: Cover; printed page 6 alignment analysis; printed pages 7-9 treaty references and summary
primary_sources.support: Page 6 identifies Salween thalweg as border for 81 miles to the Moei confluence. This supplies a concrete river-channel alignment criterion to investigate rather than choosing one administrative polygon.
primary_sources.missing: No modern surveyed channel geometry, coordinates or datum precise enough for held cell. No cell-level inference or current sovereignty conclusion. Historical report's no-known-disputes statement applies to its 1966 context only.
primary_sources.followup_route: Obtain authoritative dated local Salween channel/boundary survey or bilateral demarcation map; study references native map series and official pre-independence Survey of India maps, plus 1894 exchanged signed three-sheet maps and Aitchison vol XIV pp100-101. These underlying sheets were not inspected.
primary_sources.license: No explicit reproduction license inspected. Citation and short paraphrase only; PDF not downloaded or redistributed.

primary_sources.title: geoBoundaries MMR ADM3 metadata
primary_sources.support: BoundaryID MMR-ADM3-66882298, Township, represented 2019, source Myanmar Analytics Project / USAID; source update 2023-01-19, build 2023-12-12. Confirms independent upstream lineage, not boundary authority.
primary_sources.license: Metadata states CC BY 4.0. Retained original attribution preserves exact terms and unverified authority/effective-date limits.

primary_sources.title: geoBoundaries THA ADM1 metadata
primary_sources.support: BoundaryID THA-ADM1-36821470, represented 2017, source OpenStreetMap / Wambacher; source update 2023-01-19, build 2023-12-12. Different source/vintage can explain a competing mapping lineage but does not diagnose exact geometrical cause.
primary_sources.license: Metadata states ODbL 1.0. Preserve this distinct upstream license; geoBoundaries derivative statement does not independently clear underlying use or territorial authority.

primary_sources.title: MIMU GIS Resources
primary_sources.support: Describes its geospatial datasets as intermediate scale 1:250000 in geographic coordinates with WGS1984 datum. MIMU maps are operational products and do not imply UN endorsement of boundaries.
primary_sources.limit: General dataset description only; no Hpapun/Mae Hong Son cell-specific map or dataset inspected. No transfer of these properties to geoBoundaries products asserted.

primary_sources.title: MIMU Terms and Conditions
primary_sources.support: Sections 2.1-2.3 limit commercial use and require special written permission for geospatial dataset copying/distribution and online use; 5.2 requires permission to embed datasets; 6.1 disclaims a boundary/legal-status opinion; 7 disclaims accuracy guarantees.
primary_sources.limit: Terms are a source-use gate, not territorial evidence or a new approval process. No MIMU dataset was downloaded or proposed for embedding.

access_limits: MIMU legacy Hpapun district PDF URL and guessed old maps/township-overview routes inaccessible through web tool. Current homepage, GIS resources and township profiles page accessible.
Current MIMU township profiles page has 2019 GAD catalogue but web text searches Hpapun/Papun found no entry; no township report inspected.
Myanmar Analytics upstream resource page was inaccessible through web tool. geoBoundaries source metadata remains an attributed provider claim.
No authoritative local modern Salween survey, treaty annex geometry, bilateral boundary coordinates or datum transformation acquired.
conclusion: Retain held status for cell (202111,117535). Evidence concretely explains distinct source lineage and identifies Salween thalweg as historical alignment criterion. It does not locate the held cell relative to an authoritative channel or prove a whole-footprint exception. No new helper or clearance exists.
